title.narrative: Gearing up to End TB in Zimbabwe - Zimbabwe (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Zimbabwe, Tuberculosis, The Ministry of Health and Child Care of the Republic of Zimbabwe (MOHCC)This program has the following goals: By 2025 to have reduced the incidence of all forms of TB by 80% from 242/100000 in 2015 to 48/100000. BY 2025 to have reduced mortality of all forms of TB by 80% from 40/100000 to 8/100000. The objectives of this program are: To increase the treatment coverage of all forms of TB from 72% in 2015 to 85% (with contribution from childhood TB increasing from 7% to 12% and from non-NTP providers increasing from 13% to 20%) by 2020. To increase treatment success rate for all forms of tuberculosis from 81% in 2014 to 90% by 2020. To increase the number of DR-TB cases detected and enrolled on treatment annually from 468 (43%) in 2015 to 900 (80%) and treatment success rate from 59% (2013) to 85% by 2020.. To test all TB patients for HIV and initiate all co-infected on CPT and ART as well as intensify TB case finding among PLHIV.
